name: Indomethacin
sections: Pale yellow to yellow-tan crystalline powder, practically insoluble in water.
One of the first potent NSAIDs; also used to close patent ductus arteriosus in neonates. First approval/introduction: Patented 1961; approved 1963 (Merck & Co.).

Potent non-selective inhibitor of COX-1 and COX-2; strong anti-inflammatory and anti-gout effect. Sustained-release capsule extends action. Receptor / target profile: Potent non-selective COX-1/COX-2 inhibitor.
Summary: Well absorbed; SR provides prolonged release. ~99% protein bound. Hepatic metabolism, enterohepatic recirculation. Half-life 4.5 h (variable).
